title.ko: 서사 시제: past simple · past continuous · past perfect · would 습관 · historic present
title.en: narrative tenses and storytelling: past simple, continuous, perfect, would for habits and the historic present

explain.ko: 이야기를 할 때는 시제로 사건의 순서와 배경을 구분합니다. 과거형(arrived, called)은 줄거리를 전개하고, 과거진행형(was walking, was raining)은 진행 중인 배경을 나타내며, 과거완료(had left)는 이미 일어난 앞선 사건을 나타냅니다. 과거의 반복적 습관은 would(As a child, we would swim)와 used to로 표현합니다. 생생함을 주기 위해 역사적 현재(He opens the door ...)를 쓰기도 합니다. one day, suddenly, eventually 같은 연결어도 중요합니다.
explain.en: In storytelling, tenses signal sequence and background. The past simple (arrived, called) moves the plot forward, the past continuous (was walking, was raining) gives ongoing background, and the past perfect (had left) shows an earlier event. Repeated past habits use would (As a child, we would swim) and used to. The historic present (He opens the door ...) can add vividness. Linkers such as one day, suddenly and eventually matter too.

notes.ko: would는 과거의 반복적 행동에 쓰고 상태에는 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Would is for repeated actions, not states.
Separate background description from main events.

notes.ko: 역사적 현재는 구어와 소설에서 극적인 효과를 줍니다.
notes.en: The historic present adds drama in speech and fiction.

lines.t: When telling a story, distinguish the tenses. Use the past simple for main events, the past continuous for background, and the past perfect for earlier events. Use would or used to for past habits, and sometimes the present tense for vividness.

trans.ko: 이야기를 할 때는 시제를 구분해야 합니다. 주요 사건은 과거형, 배경은 과거진행형, 앞선 일은 과거완료로 나타냅니다. 과거의 습관은 would나 used to를 쓰고, 생생하게 전달하고 싶을 때는 현재형을 쓰기도 합니다.

lines.t: How should I begin the story?
Show the setting first. It was raining and the street was empty.

작가: 그다음에는요?

items.passage:
SHORT STORY
The lost key
It was raining that night. At the door I searched for my key, but I had already left it somewhere. Then a neighbour opened a window and called out. Only then did I realise the key had been in my pocket.

prompt.ko: 과거의 한 사건을 배경·전개·전환점·결말이 있는 4문장 이야기로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Tell a past event in 4 sentences: setting, development, turning point, ending.

task.model: One winter evening, I was reading a book while waiting for a train. By then, everyone on the platform had already left. At that moment an old man approached and handed me a worn letter. Eventually, I realised it was one I had lost long ago.

model_trans.ko: 어느 겨울 저녁, 나는 기차를 기다리며 책을 읽고 있었습니다. 승강장에는 이미 사람들이 모두 떠난 뒤였습니다. 그 순간 한 노인이 다가와 낡은 편지 한 통을 건넸습니다. 마침내 나는 그 편지가 오래전 잃어버린 내 것이었음을 알게 되었습니다.
model_trans.en: One winter evening, I was reading a book while waiting for a train. By then, everyone on the platform had already left. At that moment an old man approached and handed me a worn letter. Eventually, I realised it was one I had lost long ago.
